faq: What do you need from me to start?
Twenty or more real samples of each document type, and a list of the fields you want with a short note on each. We confirm the field list with you in writing before building anything.

It depends on how clean and consistent your documents are. We measure results on your own samples, share the numbers, and mark unsure values so a person checks them. We do not promise a fixed accuracy figure.
Can it handle documents in different layouts?
Yes, within limits. Each package states how many layouts it covers, and we test every layout on real samples. New layouts later can be added as a small extra job.
Will you see my private documents?
We only open the samples you share, inside your own accounts, and we do not keep copies after handover. If a document holds sensitive details, tell us and we can use cropped or masked samples.

desc:
Data extraction from documents into clean fields takes over the retyping of names, dates, totals and line items. Ecom Swift LLC builds a reader for your document types and sends each result to a sheet or database row, with unsure values marked.

## What is data extraction from documents?

Data extraction is the process of finding specific facts inside a document and writing them into named fields. A purchase order becomes a row with supplier, order number, date, total and items. A delivery note becomes a record with carrier, reference and quantities. The layout can differ from one sender to the next, but the fields you need stay the same.

It differs from simply reading text. Reading gives you the words on the page. Extraction gives you the right words in the right columns.

## Why retyping documents is a costly habit

Many teams still open a PDF, read a figure and type it into a sheet. It feels small, but it adds up across hundreds of documents. People get tired, a digit is swapped, a line item is skipped and the error sits unnoticed in the data until someone builds a report or sends a payment.

There is also a hidden cost in attention. The person who retypes documents is rarely the person best placed to spot problems or talk to suppliers. Their time is used on copying, not on judgment.

## How extraction affects accuracy, cost and speed

Moving the typing to a reader means results arrive in a consistent shape the moment a document is processed. Fields are always spelled and formatted the same way, which makes sorting, filtering and totals reliable. Your team's time moves from entering data to checking the items that were marked unsure.

Speed improves because processing does not queue behind a person's calendar. Cost falls for the same reason, though the amount depends on document volume and variety. Accuracy is a shared job: the reader is tested on your samples, and a review column ensures doubtful values are looked at rather than trusted blindly.

## What a good extraction set-up includes

- A written field list per document type, with the exact name and format of each field.
- Support for header fields such as supplier, date and reference.
- Line items captured as separate rows, not squeezed into one cell.
- Totals and tax checked against the lines where your document allows.
- A confidence mark on each value, with a review column for the unsure ones.
- Tolerance for layouts that vary between senders of the same document type.
- Output to Google Sheets, Excel or a database table.
- A link from each result back to its source file for fast checking.
- Notes on how to add a new document type later.

## What we do

We begin with your samples. You send documents of each type you want read, and we agree the field list with you, down to the format of dates and the way totals are written. Then we build the reader and run it on your samples, comparing every extracted value with the page.

We keep a list of what the reader gets wrong and fix the causes: a field that moves, a stamp that covers text, a column the reader confuses. The Basic package handles one document type with a defined set of fields and a sheet. Standard covers several types, line items and a review column. Premium builds a flow that runs on files placed in a folder and sends results to a sheet or database, with notes on adding a type yourself.

## Do and avoid

**Do:**
- Define the fields you actually use before asking for more.
- Include odd samples, such as a skewed scan or a new supplier layout.
- Keep a person responsible for the review column.
- Link every result to its source document.
- Re-test when a regular sender changes their document design.

**Avoid:**
- Asking for dozens of fields that nobody looks at.
- Sending only perfect documents and expecting the same results on poor ones.
- Skipping review of values marked unsure.
- Sending different document types into one undefined field list.
- Feeding extracted data straight into payments without any check.

## Who this service is for

It suits a distributor whose staff retype purchase orders into a stock sheet. It suits a freelancer or small agency receiving expense paperwork each month. It also suits an operations team that handles proof-of-delivery documents and needs references and quantities in one table.

## What we need from you

Send a set of sample documents for each type, a list of the fields you want and a note on where results should go. If the documents are private, tell us how you want them handled and we will work only in the place you name. We never ask for passwords. When a sheet or database is involved, you can give us editor or developer access to that single item, and remove it after delivery.
